description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) When are our names written in the book of life and when are our names removed from the book of life?
.
2.) I don't get this right, is it true that women should always be over their heads in church? Or what is Paul really addressing?
.
3.) "My question will be about the Christmas tree. On Adventist Home, page 482 par. 1 EGW wrote ""God would be well pleased if on Christmas each church would have a Christmas tree on which shall be hung offerings, great and small, for these houses of worship.""
Therefore, what is the background on which EGW said this?  And if we are allowed to do this, doesn't this promote idol worship in churches?"
.
4.) "I have a question, first let me tell you about my understanding of this issue as an SDA, we know that when Jesus comes the promise of John 14:1-3 will be fulfilled as Jesus will take us to heaven to where His Father is, and there we will spend 1000 years and saints will participate in Judgement and after 1000 years is expired Jesus and redeem with the holy city will descend to earth and at that moment the second resurrection will take place and wicked of all ages will surround the holy city and fire will fall down from heaven and will devour sinners and after those sinners are destroyed according to their works done to the body, ultimately God will create the new heaven and new earth where righteousness will dwell where no sin is present, with new Jerusalem as a capital city of the universe. 
But in Isaiah 65:20 it seems like they're going to be death and curse, while on new earth those things will never be present according to Revelation 21:3-4, and Revelation 22:3, and In Isaiah 65:20, Bible seems to explain this in the context of the new earth, so what is your thought on this as a theologian?"
.
.
